title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain a vulnerability involving improper neutralization of argument delimiters, classified as an Argument Injection flaw. This vulnerability allows a high privileged attacker with remote access to potentially elevate their privileges within the system. The flaw is identified as CWE-88 and carries a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.2.
